name: k05-kirana-nagpur-offer
prompt:
A small kirana shop in Nagpur at mid-morning: the owner (a man in his forties, a cream half-sleeve shirt, a red tilak on his forehead, short neat hair, a moustache) stands behind his counter under hanging strips of solid-colour snack packets with no lettering, reading his phone with a slight smile; behind him shelves of unbranded jars and packets; a customer's shoulder at the edge of the frame. Medium shot, daylight from the street, the owner's face and phone sharp.

Photorealistic cinematic film still, live action, 35 mm, eye level, shallow depth of field, natural light, real skin and fabric. Every pack and carton is unbranded: plain kraft-brown cartons with a sage-green band, solid-colour snack packets (amber, green, red) with no lettering, Mango Drink as small plain yellow-orange tetra packs with no lettering. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no number plate anywhere. No children.
